WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT e.id AS estudiante_id,NULL::bigint AS docente_id FROM public.estudiantes e
  WHERE $1='ESTUDIANTE' AND e.id=$5::bigint AND e.cedula=$2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL::bigint,d.id FROM public.docentes d
  WHERE $1='DOCENTE' AND d.id=$5::bigint AND d.cedula=$2
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_usuarios(
    tipo_usuario,estudiante_id,docente_id,cedula_manual,nombres_manual,correo_manual,estado
  )
  SELECT $1,candidate.estudiante_id,candidate.docente_id,
    CASE WHEN $1='INVITADO' THEN $2 END,
    CASE WHEN $1='INVITADO' THEN $3 END,
    CASE WHEN $1='INVITADO' THEN $4 END,'ACTIVO'
  FROM (SELECT 1) seed LEFT JOIN candidate ON TRUE
  WHERE ($1='INVITADO' OR candidate.estudiante_id IS NOT NULL OR candidate.docente_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.parqueadero_usuarios pu
      LEFT JOIN public.estudiantes e ON e.id=pu.estudiante_id
      LEFT JOIN public.docentes d ON d.id=pu.docente_id
      WHERE COALESCE(e.cedula,d.cedula,pu.cedula_manual)=$2
    )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT TRUE AS success,id::int AS id FROM inserted;
